summary.en: The Israel Innovation Authority (IIA) is the support and investment arm of the Israeli government, in charge of planning and executing the country's national innovation policy. Established in 1965 as the Office of the Chief Scientist (OCS) and renamed in 2016, it runs dozens of non-dilutive grant programs (Tnufa, Startup Fund, Technological Incubators, Innovation Labs, bilateral funds and more) for entrepreneurs and companies at all stages.

summary.en: Established in 1991, the Israel Innovation Authority's Technological Incubators Program licenses ~15 incubators across Israel that turn innovative technological concepts into companies. Startups typically receive a joint public-private investment of up to NIS 5M (~$1.5M), with the Authority funding up to 85% of early-stage project costs. The program has created over 2,500 startups. A 2025 deep-tech track raises cumulative state grants to as much as NIS 21M (~$6.25M) per company.

summary.en: Yozma was the seminal 1993 Israeli government venture capital program credited with kick-starting the country's VC industry. The government invested $100M — $20M into the Yozma Fund itself and $80M matching ten new private VC funds (each requiring a foreign VC partner), retaining a 40% equity stake with a five-year buy-out option. The funds were largely privatized; the original government program ended (the Yozma Fund became the private Yozma Group in 1997).

summary.en: The Israeli Citizens' Fund is Israel's sovereign wealth fund, established and operational from June 2022, managed by the Bank of Israel and funded by windfall (super-profit) taxes on the Tamar and Leviathan natural-gas fields. It reached about $2B in assets by end-2024. Critically for this segment, by law it invests only overseas in foreign currency to protect the shekel — it does not invest in Israeli startups — so it is an in-scope national/sovereign fund but not a startup-funding vehicle.
summary.local: קרן אזרחי ישראל היא קרן העושר הריבונית של ישראל, שהחלה לפעול ביוני 2022, מנוהלת על-ידי בנק ישראל וממומנת ממיסי רווחי-יתר על מאגרי הגז תמר ולוויתן. על-פי חוק היא משקיעה רק בחו"ל ולא בסטארט-אפים ישראליים.
